# Dedication

For everyone who has watched a supermarket basil collapse in a fortnight.

::: contents

# Introduction

If you have ever brought home a pot of supermarket basil and watched it collapse within a fortnight, this book is for you. I have done it more times than I like to admit.

Right. Let's go and look at your windows.

# Chapter 1: Read Your Windows Before You Buy a Plant

Your basil did not die because you are bad with plants. It died because of where you put it.

## North, East, South and West

A north-facing sill gets soft, even light all day and almost no direct sun.

::: takeaways
- Check the light before you buy the plant.
- Move a pot a little at a time and watch how the leaves respond over the following week.
:::

Next, we choose a pot that fits the sill you have.

# About the Author
